title: Finavia: Landside cafes to Helsinki Airport - Arrivals & Departures
description: Finavia grants possession of two (2) landside business premises, “units”, to an Operator specializing in offering café atmosphere and café products. Both units are located in the new and beautiful landside terminal. One unit is in the arrivals floor and the other one in departure floor. There are some technical restrictions in the units especially in the arrivals floor unit, that the Tenderer shall understand from the floor plans. In our vision, the landside cafés offer a well-defined and inviting selection of local fresh products made with care. The cafés have an emphasis on creating a “Welcome to Finland” atmosphere along with speed of high-quality service. The units shall be open to all potential customers during the opening hours. When-ever the cafes are seen, they invite the customers to enjoy a moment at Helsinki Airport in an open concept space that embodies a world of stylish Finnish design, peace and friendly service, which stands for "the best of the best". Our vision is to offer world-class services for airlines and air passengers. At the heart of our strategy is the development of Helsinki Airport. World class customer experience will distinguish us from our competitors. Our customer promise “for smooth travelling” underlines the vision and kept by actions lead by customer experience pillars: GIFT OF TIME "I have time to do the things I like" CONFIDENCE "I have a feeling that I am on top of things" REFRESHED "I feel good - body, mind and soul" FINNISH EXPERIENCE "I experience something unique". Finavia awards possession of two (2) business premises located in the beautiful new landside terminal of Helsinki Airport, to an Operator specializing in café operations. The units are located in arrivals floor and departures floor. Arrivals Floor unit: The very central and visible location combined with the technical restrictions in the arrivals floor unit require absolute perfection in customer service, taking into account the many aspects of the open concept of the space and co-existence operations as well as high volume location and the need of minute planning of daily operations due to special characteristics and technical limitations of the location. This unit best serves as a satellite unit as it is very limited what products can be prepared in this unit. The unit requires a unique, high-end design with high-quality natural interior surface materials and look&feel. No walls or fences are allowed to be built around the units seating area. The product portfolio of the unit is concise and easy to comprehend. The unit is strongly communicating "Welcome to Finland". A skilled and dedicated staff creates a pleasant ambience. The Unit: Ref. of floor plan: H1303 Size: approximately 167,5 m² open space. No walls or fences allowed to be built around the unit’s seating area Location: Central location in landside terminal arrivals floor The Collaboration Agreement will enter into force (Commencement date) 30 November 2022 on estimation. The construction of the premises is planned to start 1 February 2023. The opening date is planned to be 1 March 2023. As this unit does not have a preparation kitchen, the daily activities of preparing and resupplying must be carefully planned. Tenant shall carefully read and understand the technical restrictions given in the floor plans. The central location requires continuous low-key maintenance and excellent level of cleanliness. Departures Floor unit: The unique location in the beautiful departures floor combined with the busy passenger operations in that floor creates an excellent business opportunity for café operations. In the product portfolio it is possible to have larger variety of products than in the arrivals floor. This departure floor unit is a unit where passengers will meet and greet each other and have a cup of coffee, some sweet and savory pastries or even a glass of sparkling wine before heading over to their flight. The unit requires a unique, high-end design with high-quality natural interior surface materials and look&feel. The unit is strongly communicating stylish and welcoming atmosphere. A skilled and dedicated staff creates a pleasant ambience. Ref. of floor plan: H2214 Size: approximately 285 m² incl. 65 m² of terrace and 6 m² of emergency exits. Location: Landside terminal departures floor The construction of the premises is planned to start 2 January 2023. The opening date is planned to be 1 March 2023. Both units: Excellent customer service is one of the key objectives, for which it is salient that the opening hours of all the premises of the airport are unified. Finavia shall be entitled to determine the opening hours towards this objective from time to time, and separate seasonal hours may apply. The duration of the concession shall be five (5) years. Premises will be leased so that the successful Tenderer, "Operator", pays the Airport an agreed percentage of turnover generated each month at Helsinki Airport, but at least a business plan based minimum collaboration fee. Finavia sets suitability requirements to the Tenderers. Tenderer's own conditions and terms may not be included to the Tender. Questions regarding the procurement and Tenders may only be sent via Tarjouspalvelu supplier portal. Questions and/or Tenders submitted in other ways or parts thereof will not be accepted without the request of Finavia. The procurement documentation, including the Agreement, any security details, floor plans and required brands etc. are available only against a duly filled-in and signed Non-Disclosure Undertaking. The NDU form is available in Hanki Tarjouspalvelu for registered users. Registration to Hanki Tarjouspalvelu supplier portal is free of charge. Registration is supported by Hanki Tarjouspalvelu support, which is to be contacted in any matter regarding registration, completing and/or submitting offers. To avoid confusion, Candidates are advised to register to Hanki Tarjouspalvelu using the company name and ID of the entity that shall sign the Agreement. Upon receipt of the signed NDU, Finavia provides a link (by email, to the email the NDU was received from) to a secure download location, from where the Tenderer may download the entire material. The signed NDU shall be sent to hankintapaallikot@finavia.fi with subject: "Airside Fashion and Accessories to Helsinki Airport". The technical documentation is subject to change due to the nature of construction planning and processes. Questions regarding the procurement and Tenders may only be sent via Tarjouspalvelu supplier portal. Questions and/or Tenders submitted in other ways or parts thereof will not be accepted without the request of Finavia. In issues concerning registration (incl. the Tenderer's user and contact information in the system), submission of Tender on Tarjouspalvelu.fi supplier portal, contact Cloudia support. Instructions are available in English at http://tarjoajat.cloudia.fi/en/support/home. To avoid confusion, Finavia recommends that the company that would sign the possible Agreement registers with Tarjouspalvelu. Participants are obliged to familiarize themselves with any additional questions and the answers given to them before submitting the registration / tender, even if the participant has not asked any questions about the tender. The answers to the questions answered are part of the invitation to participate / invitation to tender.

title: Planerisch-technische sowie juristische Beratungsleistungen zur Begleitung des geförderten Breitbandausbaus im Landkreis Nordsachsen
description: Abschnitt I: Öffentlicher Auftraggeber I.1) Name und Adressen Offizielle Bezeichnung: Landkreis Nordsachsen Postanschrift: Schloßstraße 27 Postleitzahl / Ort: 04860 Torgau Land: Deutschland NUTS-Code: DED53 E-Mail: zentrale-vergabestelle@lra-nordsachsen.de Internet-Adresse(n) Hauptadresse: (URL) https://www.landkreis-nordsachsen.de/ I.2) Gemeinsame Beschaffung I.3) Kommunikation Die Auftragsunterlagen stehen für einen uneingeschränkten und vollständigen direkten Zugang gebührenfrei zur Verfügung unter: (URL) https://www.evergabe.de/unterlagen/54321-Tender-1886b14f019-11a862f7c2687aee Weitere Auskünfte erteilt/erteilen die oben genannten Kontaktstellen Angebote oder Teilnahmeanträge sind einzureichen elektronisch via: (URL) www.evergabe.de an die oben genannten Kontaktstellen I.4) Art des öffentlichen Auftraggebers Regional- oder Kommunalbehörde I.5) Haupttätigkeit(en) Allgemeine öffentliche Verwaltung Abschnitt II: Gegenstand II.1) Umfang der Beschaffung II.1.1) Bezeichnung des Auftrags: Planerisch-technische sowie juristische Beratungsleistungen zur Begleitung des geförderten Breitbandausbaus im Landkreis Nordsachsen Referenznummer der Bekanntmachung: 2023_WiFö_002 II.1.2) CPV-Code Hauptteil 79000000-4 II.1.3) Art des Auftrags Dienstleistungen II.1.4) Kurze Beschreibung: Im Landkreis Nordsachsen gibt es Gebiete, in denen Netze mit hochleistungsfähigen Breitbandanschlüssen gegenwärtig nicht vorhanden sind. Es bedarf einer flächendeckenden Versorgung des gesamten Kreisgebietes mit einem Netz an hochleistungsfähigen Breitbandanschlüssen (Next Generation Access (NGA)-Netze). Zum Aufbau und Betrieb von hochleistungsfähigen Breitband-Netzen in den unterversorgten Gebieten wurden dem Landkreis Nordsachsen entsprechende Fördermittel vom Bund und vom Freistaat Sachsen gewährt. Fördergegenstand ist der Aufbau und der Betrieb von NGA-Netzen im sog. "Wirtschaftlichkeitslückenmodell". Der Landkreis Nordsachsen beabsichtigt die Planung, die Errichtung und den Betrieb von NGA-Netzen im Wirtschaftlichkeitslückenmodell zu fördern und die entsprechenden Errichtungs- und Betriebsleistungen gemäß den fördermittelrechtlichen Vorgaben auszuschreiben. Der Landkreis Nordsachsen sucht für die Vorbereitung, Begleitung und Auswertung von europaweiten Ausschreibungsverfahren zur Breitbanderschließung von drei Projektgebieten im sog. Wirtschaftlichkeitslückenmodell je einen fachlich kompetenten und wirtschaftlich zuverlässigen Dienstleister für planerisch-technische Beratungsleistungen (Los 1) sowie juristische Beratungsleistungen (Los 2). title: Fourniture et intégration d'une capacité de reconnaissance et d'identification optronique jour/nuit sur des Patrouilleurs..
description: Fourniture et intégration d'une capacité de reconnaissance et d'identification optronique jour/nuit sur des Patrouilleurs, pour répondre à un besoin urgent de la Marine nationale, maintien en condition opérationnelle de ladite capacité et réalisation de prestations associées. | Le marché consiste à fournir, intégrer et maintenir un système de reconnaissance et d'identification optronique jour/nuit à bord de Patrouilleurs de la Marine nationale. Le marché répond à un besoin catégorisé " urgence opérationnelle ". Le système, basé de préférence sur un produit sur étagère, doit notamment être capable d'identifier, par exemple, une embarcation légère de type zodiac à environ 1500 m avec un état de mer 4. Le système doit disposer d'un télémètre laser. La tête du système sera intégrée dans la mature des patrouilleurs, sur une vergue à concevoir et à installer, et ne devra pas dépasser une masse de l'ordre de 35 kg.Le système doit pouvoir rallier toute cible d'intérêt provenant du radar de navigation du bâtiment. Le marché comprend notamment, les prestations suivantes :- une étude intégration du système,- la fourniture des systèmes optroniques et des vergues,- les essais à quai et en mer ,- le maintien en condition opérationnelle,- les prestations associées comprenant notamment la formation, la documentation d' utilisation et de maintenance et les rechanges. | 35700000 | Pour l'exécution, les prestations seront réalisées dans les locaux et usines du titulaire ou de ses éventuels sous-contractants. La livraison et l'installation des systèmes se dérouleront à bord des patrouilleurs de la Marine nationale, au port de la base navale militaire de Cherbourg ou dans un autre port situé entre Dunkerque et Brest. Les rechanges seront livrés à Cherbourg. Les documents seront livrés à Paris. | FR | Le marché porte sur la fourniture, l'intégration et l'installation de trois systèmes (quantité donnée à titre indicatif), le maintien en conditions opérationnelles pour une durée de l'ordre de trois ans à compter de la réception du premier système ainsi que sur la réalisation de prestations associées, selon la description de la rubrique ll.1.5 " description succincte du marché ". | En application des articles R. 2113-4 à R. 2113-6 (rendus applicables par l'article R. 2313-2) du code de la commande publique, le marché pourra éventuellement comporter une ou plusieurs tranche(s) optionnelles selon les modalités qui seront explicitées dans le dossier de consultation. Les prestations faisant l'objet de tranches optionnelles sont susceptibles de s'ajouter aux prestations commandées de manière ferme. L'acheteur se réserve le droit de ne pas affermir ces tranches. | 44

title: Achizitionare aparatura topografica (Lot 1 – Statii Totale mecanice; Lot 2 – Sisteme Rover GNSS-RTK; Lot 3 – Nivele digitale; Lot 4 – Statie Totala robotizata)
description: Obiectul achizitiei il constituie: • Lot 1 - achizitionarea unui numǎr de 3 (trei) Statii Totale mecanice, pentru măsurarea distanțelor prin emiterea unui fascicul de lumină si fascicul laser către punctul de interes, avand o acuratete marita; • Lot 2 - achizitionarea unui numǎr de 2 (doua) ROVER GNSS-RTK pentru determinarea cu precizie centimetrica a coordonatelor geografice si transcalculul acestora in sistemul national de proiectie STEREO 70; • Lot 3 - achizitionarea unui numǎr de 4 (patru) Nivele digitale pentru trasarea unghiurilor drepte, inregistrarii profilurilor transversale si longitudinale si determinarea optica a distantele, cu o acuratete marita; • Lot 4 - achizitionarea unui numǎr de 1 (una) Statie Totala robotizata pentru măsurarea distanțelor si determinarea punctelor de interes; Produsele vor trebui sa respecte toate reglementarile legale in vigoare. Aparatura topografica va indeplini conditiile de utilizare in conformitate cu specificatiile tehnice si va face dovada unor performante corespunzatoare cu cerintele tehnice în activitatea de masuratori geodezice. Termenul limita pana la care operatorii economici interesati de participarea la procedura de achizitie publica au dreptul de a solicita clarificari in legatura cu documentatia de atribuire este de 8 zile inainte de termenul limita de depunere a ofertelor. Autoritatea contractanta va raspunde in mod clar si concret la toate solicitarile de clarificari in a 4-a zi inainte de termenul stabilit pentru depunerea ofertelor.
